track.title: Imperial Grant
track.reward: Gain 3 Coins or 1 Clay + 1 Wood + 1 Coin.
track.rewardZh: 获得3铜钱，或1泥、1柴和1铜钱。

track.title: Imperial Priority
track.reward: Take your Imperial Priority token. Once per game, before or after your worker action, spend it to load 1 unloaded Glazed ceramic into your empty Imperial Kiln.
track.rewardZh: 获得御烧优先标记。每局一次，在你的工人行动之前或之后，花费它将1件未装窑的已施釉陶瓷装入空置御窑。

track.title: Imperial Audience
track.reward: Gain 6 VP. Each later Crown scores 1 VP.
track.rewardZh: 获得6 VP。之后每个 👑 获得1 VP。
